summary: Mercury's own sub-period at the start of its mahadasha (about 2 years 4 months 27 days) is favourable in every classical source: learning, fame, gains through relatives, success in undertakings, a good house and clothes. BPHS turns it bad when Mercury is debilitated, in the 6th, 8th or 12th, or with malefics, and warns of distress to the wife and deaths in the family when Mercury rules the 2nd or 7th.
common_outcomes: pearls and gems, learning, success in education, fame, meeting new dignitaries, wealth, happiness from wife, children and parents (BPHS 58.1-3)
devotion to virtue, company of the learned, a clear mind, money through Brahmins, fame from learning, lasting happiness (Phaladeepika 21.57)
beautiful houses and clothes, money through Brahmins and relatives, success in every undertaking (Jataka Parijata 18.134)
a fine house and clothes, money through relatives, success, gain of a brother or sister, growth of the family, business gains, charity, study of mathematics and arts (Raman, p. 266)
rare_outcomes: distress to the wife, deaths in the family, rheumatism and stomach pain when Mercury rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 58.4-5)
overwork and its effects, headaches (Rele, p. 96)

by_area.personality: A clear, unbiased mind and devotion to virtue (Phaladeepika 21.57); good mind (Raman).
by_area.career: Success in studies and fame; meeting new superiors (BPHS 58.1-3); success in every undertaking (Jataka Parijata 18.134). Anxiety in official duties when Mercury is afflicted (BPHS 58.1-3).
by_area.finance: Wealth, gems, business gains (BPHS 58.1-3; Raman); loss of wealth and cattle when Mercury is debilitated or in a dusthana (BPHS 58.1-3).
by_area.health: Stomach pain and illness when Mercury is afflicted (BPHS 58.1-3); rheumatism when it rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 58.4-5); headaches (Rele).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from wife (BPHS 58.1-3); distress to the wife when Mercury rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 58.4-5).
by_area.family: Happiness from children and parents (BPHS 58.1-3); growth of the family and a new sibling (Raman); antagonism with kin when afflicted (BPHS 58.1-3).
by_area.spirituality: Pious deeds and virtuous conduct (BPHS 58.1-3; Phaladeepika 21.57); charity (Raman).

strengtheners: Mercury exalted or in its own sign (BPHS 58.1-3)
Mercury in the 11th, a kendra or a trikona (Rele, p. 96)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mercury debilitated, in the 6th, 8th or 12th, or with malefics (BPHS 58.1-3)
Mercury lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 58.4-5)
lagna_or_context_notes: In its own sub-period Mercury is both dasa and sub-period lord, so its position from the dasa lord is always the 1st; the texts judge it from the lagna and by dignity. Rele also judges it 'from the significator', which is Mercury itself here.

source_views.source: BPHS 58.1-5, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Mercury exalted (or similarly strong): gems, learning, pious deeds, success in studies, fame, meetings with new dignitaries, wealth, happiness from wife, children and parents. Debilitated, in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna, or with malefics: loss of wealth and cattle, antagonism with kin, stomach pains, anxiety in official duties. Lord of the 2nd or 7th: distress to wife, deaths in the family, rheumatism, stomach pains. Remedy: recite the Vishnu Sahasranama.

Debilitated, with or aspected by a malefic, or in the 6th, 8th or 12th: quarrels with relatives or brothers, abdominal pain or headache, overwork. Lord of the 2nd or 7th: loss of wife and death among relatives.

source_views.view: Example: a politician became chief minister in Mercury-Mercury. Mercury was the Sun's dispositor in the 2nd from the Sun (Vesi yoga) and lagna lord in a trine from the Moon, so its first sub-period gave success.

disagreements: Santhanam's maraka verse reads 'Mercury lord of the 2nd or 7th'; the Sanskrit gloss reads the 2nd lord who also owns the 7th. Rele adds aspect by a malefic to the bad conditions. Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman give only favourable results, without conditions.
phrasing_guidance: Present this as a good opening for study, skills, writing and family matters, unless the chart shows the listed afflictions. Do not predict deaths in the family; at most suggest attention to the spouse's and elders' wellbeing when Mercury rules the 2nd or 7th.

summary: Ketu's sub-period in Mercury's dasa (about 11 months 27 days) is mostly described as troubled: sorrow, quarrels, illness, trouble from relatives, failure in business and loss of land or vehicles. BPHS makes it good when Ketu is with benefics in a kendra or trikona, joined with the lagna lord or a yogakaraka, or in a kendra or the 11th from Mercury, and bad when Ketu is with malefics in the 8th or 12th from Mercury.
common_outcomes: trouble from relatives, mental agony, loss of comfort, fear of an enemy, failure in business (Jataka Parijata 18.135)
distress, sorrow, quarrels, confusion, trembling of the body, hostile company, loss of land and vehicles (Phaladeepika 21.58)
sorrow, disease, loss of work and dharma, bilious illness, aimless wandering, loss of property, misfortune to relatives, trouble through doctors (Raman, p. 267)
rare_outcomes: a fall from a vehicle, distress to a son, danger from the ruler, danger from scorpions and stinging creatures (BPHS 58.9-11)
a banquet with the king, honours, income from industry when well placed (BPHS 58.6-8)

by_area.personality: Confusion and mental agony (Phaladeepika 21.58; Jataka Parijata 18.135); a tendency to wrong deeds when afflicted (BPHS 58.9-11).
by_area.career: Failure in business (Jataka Parijata 18.135; Raman); loss of work (Raman). When well placed: honours, audience with the ruler, success in studies, income from industry (BPHS 58.6-8).
by_area.finance: Loss of property, land and vehicles (Phaladeepika 21.58; Raman). Late or modest gain of wealth and more cattle when well placed (BPHS 58.6-8).
by_area.health: Disease, bilious illness, trembling of the body (Phaladeepika 21.58; Raman); physical distress when Ketu is 'lord of the 2nd or 7th' (BPHS 58.12).
by_area.relationships: Quarrels and hostile or low company (Phaladeepika 21.58; BPHS 58.9-11).
by_area.family: Trouble from relatives (Jataka Parijata 18.135); distress to a son (BPHS 58.9-11); affection with kin when well placed (BPHS 58.6-8).

strengtheners: Ketu with benefics in a kendra or trikona from the lagna (BPHS 58.6-8)
Ketu with the lagna lord or a yogakaraka (BPHS 58.6-8)
Ketu in a kendra or the 11th from Mercury (BPHS 58.6-8)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Ketu with malefics in the 8th or 12th from Mercury (BPHS 58.9-11)
lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS 58.12 speaks of Ketu as 'lord of the 2nd or 7th'; nodes own no sign in this library, so that clause is kept as manual.

source_views.view: Good if Ketu is with benefics in a kendra or trikona from the lagna, joined with the lagna lord or a yogakaraka, or in a kendra or the 11th from Mercury: fitness, late gain of wealth, affection of kin, more cattle, income from industry, success in studies, fame, honours, audience and banquet with the king, clothes. Bad if Ketu is with malefics in the 8th or 12th from Mercury: fall from a vehicle, distress to a son, danger from the king, sinful deeds, scorpion danger, quarrels with menials, sorrow, disease. Lord of the 2nd or 7th: physical distress. Remedy: give a goat in charity.

Verse 9 says the results are good at the start and middle; the bad condition there is read as the dasa lord in the 8th or 12th or with malefics. Verse 12: the remedy is donating a goat.

source_views.view: Example only: a pregnancy timed to Mercury-Ketu-Saturn, with Ketu in the 5th of the saptamsa (D-7).

disagreements: BPHS gives good results under several conditions, while Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman give only troubled results with no conditions. Santhanam's bad condition is Ketu with malefics in the 8th or 12th from Mercury; the Sanskrit gloss of verse 9 reads it as the dasa lord in the 8th or 12th or with malefics. Rele counts the 6th, 8th and 12th, and counts from the lagna as well as from the dasa lord.
phrasing_guidance: Describe a short, unsettled stretch: advise patience in business, care in travel and calm handling of relatives. Give the favourable version only when the chart shows the listed placements. Avoid predicting accidents or harm to children.

summary: Venus's sub-period in Mercury's dasa (about 2 years 10 months) is one of the best parts of the period in every source: religious and charitable acts, wealth, clothes and ornaments, help from friends and rulers, married happiness. BPHS makes it bad when Venus is weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mercury, and warns of danger when Venus rules the 2nd or 7th.
common_outcomes: worship of gods, Brahmins and elders, generous gifts, devotion to duty, clothes and ornaments, meeting friends (Phaladeepika 21.59)
presents to seniors, gods and Brahmins, conduct by religion and morality, wealth, clothing and ornaments (Jataka Parijata 18.136)
wealth, clothes and jewels, good children, married happiness, prospering relatives, growing trade, knowledge, return from a long journey, betrothal if unmarried, vehicles and a house (Raman, p. 267)
rare_outcomes: a high position in government, building of a reservoir (BPHS 58.13-15)
heart disease, defamation, fever, dysentery when Venus is weak in a dusthana from Mercury (BPHS 58.16-17)
renunciation, in one example chart (Rath, Crux pp. 389-390)

by_area.personality: Inclination to religious rites and truthfulness (BPHS 58.13-15; Rele).
by_area.career: Ambitions fulfilled through the ruler and friends; a high position; extraordinary gains in business (BPHS 58.13-15); trade increases (Raman). Loss of position and credit when Venus is in a dusthana (Rele).
by_area.finance: Agricultural land, wealth and property (BPHS 58.13-15); wealth, ornaments, vehicles and a house (Raman).
by_area.health: Good health (Raman). Heart disease, fever, dysentery when Venus is weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mercury (BPHS 58.16-17).
by_area.family: Birth of good children; relatives prosper (Raman). Separation from kin when Venus is afflicted (BPHS 58.16-17).
by_area.spirituality: Religious rites, charity, building of water works (BPHS 58.13-15); worship of gods, Brahmins and elders (Phaladeepika 21.59; Jataka Parijata 18.136).

strengtheners: Venus in a kendra, trikona or the 11th from the lagna (BPHS 58.13)
Venus in a kendra, trikona or the 11th from Mercury (BPHS 58.14-15)
both planets strong, in good houses and helped by benefics (Uttara Kalamrita sl. 31-32)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Venus weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mercury (BPHS 58.16-17)
Venus lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 58.18-19)
lagna_or_context_notes: Rath's Crux (pp. 479-480) notes that when Mercury and Venus, conjoined, are the lagna and 5th lords, they form a dhimanta (intelligence) yoga and a raja yoga that work in their joint periods.

Venus in a kendra, 5th, 9th or 11th from Mercury: a high government position, wealth and property, building a reservoir, charity, religious rites, extraordinary gains in business. Venus weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mercury: heart disease, defamation, fever, dysentery, separation from kin, distress. Venus lord of the 2nd or 7th: fear of premature death. Remedy: recite the mantras of Durga.

summary: The Sun's sub-period in Mercury's dasa (about 10 months 6 days) brings royal or official favour, gold and possessions, good food and honour in the classical texts, though Raman lists mostly troubles (head and stomach pains, enemies, trouble through superiors) along with some gain. BPHS makes it good when the Sun is strong or in good houses, and bad when it is in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna or from Mercury, weak, or with Saturn, Mars or Rahu.
common_outcomes: gold, coral, horses and elephants for the household, plenty of food and drink, honour from the ruler (Phaladeepika 21.60)
clothes, ornaments and wealth, royal favour, great ease, hearing moral teachings (Jataka Parijata 18.137)
head and stomach pains, enmity, loss of respect, danger of fire, anxieties, illness of the wife, enemies, obstacles, trouble through superiors, some gain of wealth (Raman, pp. 267-268)
rare_outcomes: acquisition of land when the Sun is aspected by Mars (BPHS 58.21)
danger from thieves, fire and weapons; separation from friends (BPHS 58.23-24)

by_area.personality: Mental agony when the Sun is afflicted (BPHS 58.23-24); anxieties (Raman).
by_area.career: Fortune through the favour of high officials (BPHS 58.20-22); honour from the ruler (Phaladeepika 21.60). Trouble through superiors and loss of respect (Raman).
by_area.finance: Gold and valuables (Phaladeepika 21.60); wealth, clothes and ornaments (Jataka Parijata 18.137); land if the Sun is aspected by Mars (BPHS 58.21).
by_area.health: Bilious trouble, headaches (BPHS 58.23-24); head and stomach pains (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from friends (BPHS 58.20); separation from friends when afflicted (BPHS 58.23-24); illness of the wife (Raman).

strengtheners: Sun exalted or in its own sign, in a kendra, trikona, the 2nd or 11th, or in an exalted or own navamsa (BPHS 58.20)
aspect of Mars (land) or the lagna lord (food and clothes) (BPHS 58.21-22)
Sun and Mercury both strong (Uttara Kalamrita sl. 32-33)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Sun in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna or from Mercury, weak, or with Saturn, Mars and Rahu (BPHS 58.23-24)
Sun lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 58.25)
lagna_or_context_notes: The Sun is rarely more than one sign from Mercury, so it is usually in the 1st, 2nd or 12th from the dasa lord; the 12th from Mercury is one of the bad BPHS positions.

Sun in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna or Mercury, weak, with Saturn, Mars and Rahu: danger from thieves, fire and weapons, bile, headaches, mental agony, separation from friends. Lord of the 2nd or 7th: fear of premature death. Remedy: worship the Sun.

In the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna or dasa lord, or with a malefic: danger from fire and firearms, bile, loss of a brother. In the 2nd or 7th: accident, early death or serious illness.

BPHS gives the maraka danger for the Sun as lord of the 2nd or 7th; Rele gives it for the Sun placed in the 2nd or 7th. For the remedy, Santhanam has worship of the Sun; the Sanskrit gloss has a shanti ritual.
phrasing_guidance: Present this as a short period of dealings with authority: support from officials if the Sun is strong, friction and fatigue if afflicted. Keep health notes general (headaches, digestion). Do not mention premature death.

summary: The Moon's sub-period in Mercury's dasa (about 1 year 5 months) is mixed. BPHS gives marriage, a son, a new house, music, study and gains from abroad when the Moon is strong or linked with Jupiter, while Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman stress illness, enemies and failed plans. The Moon debilitated, in an enemy sign or weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mercury brings danger from authorities, fire and thieves and losses through women.
common_outcomes: diseases, ill will of enemies, failure of every concern, risk from four-footed animals (Jataka Parijata 18.138)
headache, eye complaints, skin disease, severe neck pain, danger to life (Phaladeepika 21.61)
ill health, swellings or hurts in the limbs, trouble through women, many difficulties, but also money through women, agriculture and trade, success and happiness (Raman, p. 268)
rare_outcomes: marriage, birth of a son, a new house, music, study of scripture, a journey south, clothes from overseas, pearls (BPHS 58.26-29)
visits to sacred places and wealth from foreign countries at the start of the sub-period (BPHS 58.31)

by_area.personality: Patience and enthusiasm when the Moon is well placed from Mercury (BPHS 58.31).
by_area.career: Failure of undertakings (Jataka Parijata 18.138); success through trade (Raman). Danger from the ruler and disgrace when the Moon is weak in a dusthana from Mercury (BPHS 58.32-33).
by_area.finance: Clothes, ornaments, gems and goods from overseas (BPHS 58.26-29); money through women, farming and trade (Raman). Loss of wealth on account of a woman, loss of crops and cattle when afflicted (BPHS 58.32-33).
by_area.health: Physical distress if the Moon is debilitated or in an enemy sign (BPHS 58.30); headache, eye and skin complaints, neck pain (Phaladeepika 21.61); swellings or hurts in the limbs (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Marriage when the Moon is strong (BPHS 58.26-27); trouble and quarrels through women (Raman; BPHS 58.32-33).

source_views.source: BPHS 58.26-35, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Moon in a kendra or trikona from the lagna, or exalted or in its own sign with or aspected by Jupiter, or a yogakaraka: marriage, a son, clothes and ornaments, a new house, sweet food, music, study of shastras, a journey south, clothes from overseas, pearls. Debilitated or in an enemy sign: physical distress. In a kendra, trikona, 3rd or 11th from Mercury: at the start, visits to shrines, patience, enthusiasm, wealth from abroad. Weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mercury: danger from the king, fire and thieves, disgrace, loss of wealth on account of the wife, loss of land and cattle. Lord of the 2nd or 7th: physical distress. source_views.view: Moon exalted, in its own sign, in a kendra or trikona, or aspected by Jupiter: marriage or a son, property, wealth and knowledge, music and dance, travel south. In the 3rd or 11th: prosperity abroad and pilgrimage. In the 6th or 12th or with a malefic: danger from the ruler, fire and robbers, illicit relations, loss of credit and property. In the 2nd or 7th: a severe physical ailment.

disagreements: BPHS and Rele are favourable when the Moon is strong. Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and the first half of Raman's list are troubled. Phaladeepika alone mentions danger to life. The Sanskrit gloss reads BPHS 58.34 as the 7th lord in the 2nd, Santhanam as the Moon lord of the 2nd or 7th.
phrasing_guidance: Describe this as an emotional, domestic period that can bring family events and comforts when the Moon is strong, or minor health and relationship strain when it is weak. Do not mention danger to life; at most suggest attention to rest and health.

summary: Mars's sub-period in Mercury's dasa (about 11 months 27 days) is double-edged. Jataka Parijata gives relief from illness and enemies, fame from charity and royal favour, and BPHS gives property, a son and recovery of lost position when Mars is strong. Phaladeepika and Raman stress fire, eye trouble, thieves, wounds, fevers and loss of position. BPHS gives a bad-good-bad pattern when Mars is with malefics in the 8th or 12th from Mercury.

source_views.view: Mars exalted, in its own sign, in a kendra or trikona from the lagna or with the lagna lord: government favour, more property, reinstatement in high position, a son, cattle, vehicles, land, happiness from wife. With or aspected by malefics in the 8th or 12th from the lagna: distress, mental agony, obstacles, loss of wealth, gout, wounds, weapons, fever. Aspected by benefics in a kendra, trikona or 11th from Mercury: wealth, comfort, a son, reputation, good relations with kin. With malefics in the 8th or 12th from Mercury: distress, danger from kin, the king's wrath and fire, antagonism with a son and loss of position at the start; enjoyment and gains in the middle; danger from the king and loss of position at the end. Lord of the 2nd or 7th: fear of premature death. Remedy: Mrityunjaya japa and a cow in charity.

summary: Rahu's sub-period in Mercury's dasa (about 2 years 6 months 18 days) is favourable in Jataka Parijata (wealth from friends, learning, royal favour) and in BPHS when Rahu is in a kendra or trikona or in certain signs, with trouble at the start and good results later. Phaladeepika and Raman stress loss of status, poison, fire or water dangers, skin and heat diseases and bad company. Rahu in the 8th or 12th, or with malefics in the 8th or 12th from Mercury, brings losses, fear and possible confinement.

summary: Jupiter's sub-period in Mercury's dasa (about 2 years 3 months 6 days) is good in most sources: health, wealth, royal favour, marriages and festivities at home, religious devotion and victory over enemies. Jataka Parijata and Raman also note friction with friends, relatives and elders. BPHS turns it bad when Jupiter is debilitated, combust, in the 6th, 8th or 12th, or linked with Saturn and Mars, and when it is weak in a dusthana from Mercury.
common_outcomes: freedom from illness, defeat of enemies, end of fear, success in religious practice, honour from the ruler, merit from penance (Phaladeepika 21.64)

danger from Brahmins (their wrath) when Jupiter is weak in a dusthana from Mercury (BPHS 58.64)

by_area.finance: Wealth and cattle (BPHS 58.56-58); land and trade gains (Raman). Loss of wealth, land and crops when afflicted (BPHS 58.59-61).

by_area.personality: Loss of clarity, mental agony and bad dreams when Saturn is in the 8th or 12th from Mercury (BPHS 58.69-70); gloomy thoughts (Raman). Enthusiasm when Saturn is strong (BPHS 58.67-68).
by_area.career: Gain of position, even a high post, when Saturn is strong (BPHS 58.67-68); failure in all undertakings (Phaladeepika 21.65); loss in ventures (BPHS 58.69-70); severe reversals (Raman).
by_area.finance: Heavy losses (Phaladeepika 21.65); debts and earnings through wrong means (Raman); wealth and comforts through minor chiefs, with farming losses (Jataka Parijata 18.142).
by_area.health: Phlegm and wind illnesses (Phaladeepika 21.65); pain in Saturn's parts of the body, fear of disease (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Danger from enemies, distress to wife and children (BPHS 58.69-70); enmity (Raman).
by_area.family: Well-being in the family when Saturn is strong (BPHS 58.67-68); loss of kinsmen (BPHS 58.69-70); loss of children and family breakdown (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Visits to sacred shrines (BPHS 58.67-68); charity (Jataka Parijata 18.142); loss of religious merit (Phaladeepika 21.65).

strengtheners: Saturn exalted or in its own sign, or in a kendra, trikona or the 11th from the lagna (BPHS 58.67-68)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saturn in the 8th or 12th from Mercury (BPHS 58.69-70)
Saturn lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 58.71)
lagna_or_context_notes: This is the last sub-period of the Mercury dasa, matching BPHS 47.70, which calls the end of the dasa distressing. Saturn is a friend of Mercury.

source_views.source: BPHS 58.67-72, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Saturn exalted, in its own sign, or in a kendra, trikona or 11th from the lagna: family well-being, a high position, enthusiasm, more cattle, gain of position, visits to shrines. In the 8th or 12th from Mercury: danger from enemies, distress to wife and children, loss of thinking power, loss of kin, losses in ventures, mental agony, foreign journeys, bad dreams. Lord of the 2nd or 7th: fear of premature death. Remedy: Mrityunjaya japa and giving a black cow and a female buffalo.

source_views.source: BPHS 58.67-72, Sanskrit with English gloss, enjoylearningsanskrit.com
source_views.view: Verse 69 reads the bad condition as Saturn in the 8th or 12th or involving the dasa lord. Verse 71: untimely death if the 2nd and 7th lords are involved. Verse 72: Mrityunjaya mantra and a black cow or she-buffalo for longevity and health.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 21.65
source_views.view: Heavy loss of wealth and religious merit, failure in all business, illnesses from phlegm and wind.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 18.142
source_views.view: Acts of charity, wealth, comforts through petty chiefs, loss in agriculture.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XXIV, p. 269
source_views.view: 2y 8m 9d. Bad luck, no success or happiness, severe reversal, enmity, pain in Saturn's parts of the body, disgrace to relatives, evil forebodings, fear of disease, loans, loss of children, family destruction, scandals, trouble from foreigners, earnings through evil ways, charity, wealth, comforts through petty chiefs, failure in farming.

source_views.source: V.G. Rele, Directional Astrology... Vimshottari Dasa, p. 99
source_views.view: Saturn exalted, in its own sign, a kendra, trikona or 11th: family happiness, prosperity, favour of superiors, steadiness of mind. In the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna or dasa lord: harassment from enemies, trouble with wife and children, mental aberration, loss of a brother, foreign travel.

disagreements: Phaladeepika and most of Raman's list are adverse; Jataka Parijata is mostly favourable apart from farming losses; BPHS sorts by condition. BPHS counts only the 8th and 12th from Mercury as bad; Rele adds the 6th and counts from the lagna too. Rele gives no maraka clause for Saturn.
phrasing_guidance: Present this as a demanding close to the Mercury period that rewards discipline and steady effort; advise caution with debts, ventures and family strain, and suggest rest and routine for health. Never predict premature death.

effects: [maraka: text predicts fear of premature death]

remedies.remedy: give a black cow and a female buffalo in charity
